scope: Server-side conversation ownership and current database authorization of remembered source references; no LLM, rewrite model, HTTP login or generated answer.
corpus: Original corpus.json and principals; actual PostgreSQL RLS. New disposable execution, does not alter results/isolation.json.
transactions: Each resume reads principal and references within one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction. Revocations commit before the next resume begins. No claim of immediate revocation inside an already-running snapshot.
references: Conversation stores source id and revision, not trusted source text from history. Every resume reloads each reference under the current role. Any missing/disallowed/version-mismatched reference rejects the evidence set.

cases.expected: ready with Alpha cache only; does not imply model prompt-injection safety

limits: 21 authored scenarios, known fixtures, one process, deterministic ordering. Does not resolve arbitrary linguistic followups or summarize/truncate history. Stored public synthetic references are not deployable user sessions.
